BC_description: Calling getState, subscribe, or unsubscribe on a Store instance while dispatching (including inside a reducer) now throws an error, which breaks any code that previously relied on this behavior. This change was made to prevent potential issues and ensure consistency.
Adaptation_method: Avoid calling these methods during dispatch. For example, if a reducer calls getState, refactor to not do so. Before: function reducer(state, action) { const currentState = getState(); return state; } After: function reducer(state, action) { return state; } (remove the getState call). Similarly, do not call subscribe or unsubscribe during dispatch; perform these operations outside of reducer execution or dispatch cycles.
